SELECT p.month, p.year AS year, COUNT(p.employee_id) AS totalEmployees, SUM(p.gross_salary) AS totalGross,
SUM( COALESCE(pd.tax,0) + COALESCE(pd.insurance,0) + COALESCE(pd.leave_deduction,0) + COALESCE(pd.late_deduction,0) + COALESCE(pd.other_deduction,0) ) AS totalDeduction,
SUM( p.gross_salary - ( COALESCE(pd.tax,0) + COALESCE(pd.insurance,0) + COALESCE(pd.leave_deduction,0) + COALESCE(pd.late_deduction,0) + COALESCE(pd.other_deduction,0) ) ) AS totalNetSalary,
SUM( CASE WHEN p.status = 'PENDING' OR p.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pending
FROM payroll p LEFT JOIN payroll_deduction pd ON p.id = pd.payroll_id
GROUP BY p.month, p.year;

SELECT p.id,pd.id as deduction_id, e.name AS employeeName, d.name AS departmentName, ep.title AS positionName, p.gross_salary AS grossSalary, ( coalesce(pd.tax,0)+ coalesce(pd.insurance,0)+ coalesce(pd.leave_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.late_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.other_deduction,0)) as deductionAmount , ( p.gross_salary - (coalesce(pd.tax,0)+ coalesce(pd.insurance,0)+ coalesce(pd.leave_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.late_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.other_deduction,0))) as netSalary, pd.tax, pd.insurance, pd.late_deduction as lateDeduction, pd.leave_deduction as leaveDeduction, pd.other_deduction as otherDeductions, p.month, p.year as year, p.status, p.payment_date AS paymentDate
FROM payroll p JOIN employee e ON p.employee_id = e.id JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id JOIN e_position ep ON e.position_id = ep.id LEFT JOIN payroll_deduction pd ON p.id = pd.payroll_id;
mapper.update: UPDATE payroll SET gross_salary = #{grossSalary}, status = #{status}, payment_date = #{paymentDate}, month = #{month} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE payroll_deduction SET tax = #{tax}, insurance = #{insurance}, leave_deduction = #{leaveDeduction}, late_deduction = #{lateDeduction}, other_deduction = #{otherDeductions} WHERE payroll_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll_deduction ( payroll_id, tax, insurance, late_deduction, leave_deduction, other_deduction ) VALUES ( #{id}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 )
